## Permissions
- **No more adding WhisperShortcut by hand.** When a feature needs a permission, macOS is asked first, so WhisperShortcut already appears in System Settings. You no longer have to add it with "+".
- **One place for permissions.** The Settings tab is now called "Permissions & Privacy". It shows every permission with its real status, including System Audio, and one button per row.
- **Fewer questions at the start.** Setup only asks for the microphone. Other features ask the first time you use them.
- **No surprise dialogs.** Without Screen Recording, Dictate Prompt now sends without a screenshot and tells you once, instead of opening a macOS dialog in the middle of your request.

## Settings
- **Clearer sidebar.** Settings is grouped into four sections: General, Dictation, Chat & Meetings, and More.
- The model picker no longer shows the "Compare Gemini models" link, and its hints name only models that are still offered.

## Installation
Download the DMG from the [releases page](https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/releases), open it, and drag WhisperShortcut to your Applications folder.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/mgsgde/whisper-shortcut/compare/v8.83...v8.84
